title: Recognizing The Signs Interactive Checklist
description: Students identify the five sign categories of substance use disorder (loss of control, continued use despite harm, withdrawal, life narrowing, increasing tolerance) and classify realistic scenario statements into the correct category, reinforcing that recognizing a pattern signals it is time to seek help, not to judge.
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education
chapter_title: Substance Use Disorder, Recovery, and Policy
